spoil.definition:
n. (usually plural) valuables taken by violence (especially in war)
n. the act of spoiling something by causing damage to it
n. the act of stripping and taking by force
v. become unfit for consumption or use
spoil.translation:
n. 战利品, 赃物, 奖品, 变质, 次品
vt. 损坏, 破坏, 溺爱
vi. 腐坏, 掠夺

spoil the ship for a halfpennyworth of t.word: spoil the ship for a halfpennyworth of tar

spoil-sport.translation: n. 专事破坏他人乐趣者

spoil-sports.translation: (spoil-sport 的复数) n. 专事破坏他人乐趣者

spoilage.definition:
n. the amount that has spoiled
n. the process of becoming spoiled
spoilage.translation:
n. 变质, 糟蹋, 损耗, 损坏
[经] (原料,材料,产品)损坏

spoilation.definition: n. the act of stripping and taking by force

spoilbank.translation: n. 弃土堆,废石堆,(煤矿的)矸石堆

spoiled.definition: s. having the character or disposition harmed by pampering or oversolicitous attention
spoiled.translation:
spoil的过去式和过去分词
[经] 损坏的

spoiled material.translation: [经] 损坏的材料, 废料

spoiler.definition:
n. a candidate with no chance of winning but who may draw enough votes to prevent one of the leading candidates from winning
n. an airfoil mounted on the rear of a car to reduce lift at high speeds
n. a hinged airfoil on the upper surface of an aircraft wing that is raised to reduce lift and increase drag
spoiler.translation: n. 掠夺者, 搞坏事情的人, 宠坏别人的人

spoiler alert.definition:
Usu. a term to describe when crucial elements of a movie are about to be revealed (i.e. the ending, character deaths, a twist, etc.) 
> **Spoiler Alert!**
> The girl in million dollar baby dies.

spoilers.translation: (spoiler 的复数) n. 掠夺者, 搞坏事情的人, 宠坏别人的人

spoilfive.definition:
n. A certain game at cards in which, if no player wins
   three of the five tricks possible on any deal, the game is said to be
   spoiled.

spoilsman.definition:
n. One who serves a cause or a party for a share of the
   spoils; in United States politics, one who makes or recognizes a demand
   for public office on the ground of partisan service; also, one who
   sanctions such a policy in appointments to the public service.
spoilsman.translation: n. 为了获得官职而为某政党效劳的人, 赞成政党分赃制的人

spoilsmen.translation: n. 分肥者；以获益为目的而支持政党者

spoilsmonger.definition:
n. One who promises or distributes public offices and
   their emoluments as the price of services to a party or its leaders.
spoilsmonger.translation: [美]卖官鬻爵的政党分肥制政客
